mentions.name: Low-volume web scraping project
mentions.description: This is a low-volume web scraping project that emphasizes success rate over throughput. It uses a 4G dongle as a last-resort connection method if nothing else gets through and is also investigating IPv6.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a scraping project at the moment so looking at this too but from the other end. Super low volume though so pretty tame - emphasis on success rate more than throughput

I bought a 4G dongle for use as last resort if nothing else gets through. And also investigating ipv6
